CustomField.description: Which portal features this program takes part in, as JSON flags: {"errata": true, "certification": true, "detailPage": true, "cv": true}. A flag that is absent reads as false. Each flag replaces one service's hand-written list of Contract record types — errata: may report book mistakes (GARP_Portal_ErrataService); certification: completing the program makes the member a certification holder, which sets the renewal price (GARP_Portal_MembershipService); detailPage and cv are reserved for the services that still carry literals. A service whose capability NO row claims falls back to its own literal list, so leaving this blank changes nothing and a bad value can only fail to add a feature, never take one away. Parsed strictly and independently of Config__c: a broken value here degrades only the capabilities, with a named warning on the response.
CustomField.label: Capabilities
